chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin Pasian’ nopsakna sungah tum zawh nading thu hong kiciamna in eite ading a om lai napi-in, note lakah khat peuhmah in a phak zawh loh khak ding lung hihmawhhuai hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite in Lungdamna Thu tuate mah bangin i za zo hi. Ahih hangin amau a zak uh thu in a za mite lakah upna tawh a kigawm lo ahih ciangin, phattuamna a om kei hi.

A um eite in Pasian’ nopsakna sungah i tum hi. Tua bang a genna in: ‘“Amaute in ka nopsakna sungah a tum thei kei ding uh hi,’ ci-in hehin ka kiciam hi,” a ci hi. Ahih hangin Pasian in a cil panin a na khempeuh a zo khin hi.
Ni sagih ni thu, Lai Siangtho sung mun khatah a genin, “Pasian in ama bawl na khempeuh a zawh khit ciangin, ni sagih ni-in tawhnga-in a om hi,” a ci hi.
Tua Lai Siangtho sungah a om kik in: “Amaute in ka nopsakna sungah a tum thei kei ding uh hi,” ci-in a om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin mi kimkhat a tum theih ding uh hangin, Lungdamna Thu nidang lai-inah a za mite in a up loh manunah a tum thei kei uh a,

Khatvei: “Tuni-in note in ama aw na zak uh leh, na lungsim uh na khauhsak kei un,” ci-in hih zah a sawt zo, “Tu ni,” ci-in David tungah a gen ciangin, nidang lai-in a genna bangin ni khat peuhpeuh ciamtehin a ngaihsun hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Joshua in tua mite nopsakna pia hi leh, tua nung ciangin a nidang ni thu Pasian in a gen kei ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian’ mite ading Nipi ni nopsakna a om lai hi.
Pasian in ama nasepna khempeuh zo khinin tawlnga-a a om bangin, tua nopsakna sungah a tum mi in zong ama nasepna khempeuh zoin tawlnga-in a om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Israel mite in thu ngaih lohna lungsim a neih uh ciangin, a kipuk uh bangin, kuamah kipuk loin tua nopsakna sunga tum nadingin hahkat ciat ni.

Bang hang hiam i cih leh, Pasian’ thu in nungta a, vangliatna nei a, lang nih a hiam namsau sangin hiamzaw a, nuntakna leh kha ahi zongin, guh-le-tang leh guhngeek ahi zongin, khenin pailet thei a, lungsim ngaihsutnate leh hanciamnate khempeuh a thei thei hi.
Tua tham loin, eite thu hong khenpa mai-ah a kilang lo na khat beek a om kei hi; na khempeuh a liah a dal om loin Pasian mai-ah kipho laakin a om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin vantung kheng a, pai Siampi Ukpa lian ahi Pasian’ Tapa Zeisu in, eite aa ahih ciangin eite in i man’sa thu-ah kip takin om ni.

Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, eite siampi ukpa in eite hat lohna hong hehpih zo lo mi ahi kei hi; eite thuak mah bangin ze-etna apawl apawl a thuak ngei mi, ahih hangin— mawhna khialhna nei lo ahi hi.
Tua ahih ciangin eite in hehpihna leh a kilawm hunah hong huhna thupha ngah nadingin, lau lohna lungsim tawh hehpihna’ tokhom kiangah nai ni.
